title: The data-readiness gate: assess, refuse, review, train
description: A dataset is assessed against a manifest, refused when its operating point is outside the declared validity, refused again while a warning has no engineering review, and then trained once a review record accepts that finding for that exact dataset digest. Run with: cd examples/data_readiness && python run.py

metrics.name: score_outside_validity
metrics.how: readiness() on this manifest with the operating point moved to Re = 300000 (outside [1e4, 1e5]): one critical finding, and the run refuses

metrics.name: score_missing_unit
metrics.how: readiness() with the unit of T_max removed: one warning, and the run refuses until a review accepts it

metrics.name: findings_blocking_before_review
metrics.how: units.missing, not yet accepted by a review record for this dataset digest

checks.name: a FAIL dataset cannot start a run
a WARNING dataset starts only with a review that names the finding
the run carries the reviewer and the accepted findings
